title: `voids/interested-party-void` turns evidence of bias risk into a claim of structural incapacity and leaves the strongest replies unmet. It does not engage social objectivity, externalist and fallibilist justification, or accuracy goals. It asserts that the void "contaminates all positions equally" although the most direct study (Heflick et al. 2015) ties mortality salience to afterlife belief only when dualism is facilitated. The Map's dualism-humility sentence changes nothing.
